summary: An Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee (EMDAC) meeting was held June 28, 2023, after a Complete Response cycle, to discuss whether palovarotene's post hoc analyses and external-control data supported effectiveness in FOP. The committee voted in favor on both questions (10 of 14 for effectiveness; 11 of 14 that benefits outweigh risks), citing the rarity and unmet need of FOP while acknowledging the small effect size and flawed prespecified analyses. Members' recommendations for a patient registry and for BMD monitoring and PPC screening align with the approval's postmarketing observational registry PMR and the boxed warning for premature epiphyseal closure, though the review documents do not explicitly state the AC caused these changes.
